limits: 20ms body samples,30Hz actual actuation;1ms physics receipts are not1ms body or contact-force observer data.
Native publication does not prove DDS or guard consumption; this task classifies physical producer samples only.
A sampled maximum below.01 cannot prove continuous/future side-slip tube or bound terminal accumulated motion.
Actual target linear-zero includes brake transient and is not synonymous with active settled qualification.
Target sign is not an established heading cone and the lateral statistic alone is insufficient for r when forward motion has unadmitted sign.
No runtime/control input,truth readback or source changes; all data remain isolated closed evidence.
matching_rule: Latest actual wheel update with actuation.sim_time_ns STRICTLY LESS THAN odom source_ns, because configured/code order world_update_begin_before_actuation. Matching stored cmd_seq and desired_v/w/target refs must agree. Storage separately tracked; same-clock storage ordering is unknown and never used as the actual response target.

residual_definition.lateral: abs(raw body linear.y), not a world component and not3D norm
residual_definition.normal_nonzero: r=(min(0,sign(target_v)*vx),vy) in norm; retains any measured forward component opposite the actual consumed target sign
residual_definition.purpose: Necessary observed samples for a candidate signed-sector+residual tube; does not prove heading-sector containment, continuum or future response.
residual_definition.zero_target: full hypot(vx,vy); this includes normal finite braking/settling, so >.01 here is not by itself a settled-disk counterexample

scope: Descriptive closed native producer data only, not formal audit, new simulation, future bound, science PASS or original FAIL relabel

window_basis.explanation: Declared evaluator end uses callback clock56.98; last API physically advanced to57.0 and native close to57.2. Source56.995 failure sample is outside first window but included in second/appendix. No violation is discarded or relabelled because of window labels.
